top_signals.title: Judge denies WhatsApp’s bid to hold spyware maker in contempt for allegedly targeting users
top_signals.summary: WhatsApp argued that NSO Group violated a 2025 injunction against using the messaging app to spread spyware. A federal judge said WhatsApp hurt its case by not revealing enough information.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: New Oil Fields Should Have to Build the Carbon Storage Market
top_signals.summary: The debate over new oil and gas fields usually ends in a familiar deadlock. Industry argues that production will still be needed for decades, supports jobs and reduces dependence on imports. Climate campaigners respond that every new field locks in emissions incompatible with net zero. Both sides then discuss carbon capture and storage as an afterthought: either a technological excuse for continued extraction or a costly public project unrelated to the licence being approved. top_signals.title: UK jobs market stabilises ahead of Budget

top_signals.title: Market participants weigh in on SEC’s proposed crypto regulations
top_signals.summary: The financial agency is scheduled to close public comments on its ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ proposed in August.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
